name: zvideo_dd3d_flush_quad_batch
description: zVideo_dd3d::FlushQuadBatch draws the queued solid quad batch with cached D3D render-state setup and restoration.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo sorted/overwrite/quad flush pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4ad120 validates the zvid_ddd3d.c source mapping, cdecl no-argument/no-return contract, early return on empty quad batch, and cached render-state setup for shade mode 2, alpha blend enable 1, z-write enable 0, and texture handle 0.

The function sets D3DRENDERSTATE_ZFUNC to D3DCMP_ALWAYS before drawing, draws each queued quad as D3DPT_TRIANGLEFAN with D3DVT_TLVERTEX, the quad item's four TL vertices, vertex count 4, and flags 0, then clears g_zVideo_QuadBatchCount.
After drawing, the function restores D3DRENDERSTATE_ZFUNC to D3DCMP_GREATEREQUAL, alpha blend enable to 0 when needed, and z-write enable to 1 when needed.
The dependency frontier for 0x4ad120 has no visible authored source blockers; the only calls are Direct3D SetRenderState and DrawPrimitive SDK provider vtable dependencies.

Native smokes verify empty-queue no-op behavior, non-empty setup state changes, texture handle clearing, ZFUNC state around DrawPrimitive calls, two queued quad draw calls with provider arguments, quad-count clearing, alpha/z-write restoration, and cache-hit behavior when initial cached state already matches setup.
